Barn: Which barn is it?
Barn. The board has 10x10 sites (160x160 cells). The window shows one site; each move goes to the next site (up, down, left or right). One large barn fills the board on a plain yellow field. Its parts are large black shapes: two roof marks in the top row at the left, two loft marks one above the other at the right edge, two door marks in the lower half at the left and middle, and one weather vane mark near the bottom right. Every other site is the plain yellow field. The whole picture may sit one site higher, lower, left or right. Question: Which barn is it? The answer is one of eight barns, each with its own parts: jace = the roof marks show a wide flat black bar, the loft marks show a black plus sign, the door marks show a black square, the weather vane mark shows three flat black stripes; kira = the roof marks show a black triangle pointing up, the loft marks show a black plus sign, the door marks show a black triangle pointing down, the weather vane mark shows three flat black stripes; lyle = the roof marks show a wide flat black bar, the loft marks show a black plus sign, the door marks show a black triangle pointing down, the weather vane mark shows a tall thin black bar; maeve = the roof marks show a black triangle pointing up, the loft marks show a black plus sign, the door marks show a black square, the weather vane mark shows a tall thin black bar; nils = the roof marks show a wide flat black bar, the loft marks show a black diamond, the door marks show a black triangle pointing down, the weather vane mark shows three flat black stripes; opal = the roof marks show a black triangle pointing up, the loft marks show a black diamond, the door marks show a black triangle pointing down, the weather vane mark shows a tall thin black bar; penn = the roof marks show a black triangle pointing up, the loft marks show a black diamond, the door marks show a black square, the weather vane mark shows three flat black stripes; rhys = the roof marks show a wide flat black bar, the loft marks show a black diamond, the door marks show a black square, the weather vane mark shows a tall thin black bar. Answer with its name. You may answer at any time; you do not need to see every site. Score: 20 if the answer is right, minus 10, minus 0.1 per move (movement budget 35).
The answers: 1 = jace, 2 = kira, 3 = lyle, 4 = maeve, 5 = nils, 6 = opal, 7 = penn, 8 = rhys.
